capabilities.read: Read file contents and list directory entries.
capabilities.search: Search file contents (grep/ripgrep) and find files by name or glob.
capabilities.edit: Create new files and replace or modify single blocks in existing files.
capabilities.multi_edit: Perform multi-hunk replacements across file regions.
capabilities.web: Fetch URL contents and perform web searches.
capabilities.image: Generate or edit visual assets from prompts.
